title: pacific-flexure-window-dependence: window-free recovery of flexural parameters at circum-Pacific trenches

creators.name: Lemenkova, Polina

description: Code and derived per-segment data supporting the article on analysis-window dependence in flexural parameter recovery at circum-Pacific subduction margins. Contains the trench-axis tracing pipeline, the profile extraction and correction chain, the physics-informed neural inversion, the windowed least-squares baseline and its window sweep, and one script per figure. Source grids are open access and are cited rather than redistributed; derived tables are released under CC BY 4.0 and the code under MIT.
